articles.description: Teams aren’t waiting until after the impending lockout to reinforce their rosters. But will the Dodgers be among those teams before the current CBA expires on Dec. 1?
articles.title: MLB free agent market is active, even with a looming lockout. Will Dodgers make a splash?

articles.description: The Atlanta Braves have signed relief pitcher Evan Phillips to a three-year, $35-million contract to bring the right-hander back to his original team.
articles.title: Relief pitcher Evan Phillips signs three-year deal to return to Atlanta Braves
